10 years later I still love it. 10 years ago I paid $5 for the premium version of this app. I was originally using the free version and it was so useful I wanted the full version. Perhaps the best $5 I ever spent. 

At this point, I’ve trained myself that when this app goes on, I am focused on whatever task is at hand. It got me through writing my dissertation, and is a helpful ally when reading in public spaces. If I just need a few minutes to reset, this is my go to. 

I mostly use the mixes. I don’t switch it up a lot, and I’m surprised at how I don’t get bored or annoyed by the repetition. Quite the opposite. I have used the mediations here and there (not for sleep - I don’t sleep with earbuds) and found them useful. 

Thanks to the developers more making a highly useful tool to promote calm and focus. I expect I’ll use this for another 10 years at least!

Thanks for keeping this going all these years!. I love this app. It’s so easy to tailor make your relaxing music or ambient noise mixes. Great for meditating or just taking a moment to chill out. The interface is very basic and endlessly customizable. I enjoy being able to design my own soundscape. Mostly, I use it when I am reading. I throw a little brown noise down and then try and pick sound that would go along with the book that I’m reading. There’s been so many apps over the years that I’ve purchased, and they have disappeared as Apple updates its iOS, but this one goes on and on and on. I think I’ve had it since my first or second iPhone, and I am still happy with it to this day. Love being able to save my soundscapes and the ease of use to design them. Keep up the good work!

I absolutely adore the community mixes feature, and I would encourage anyone who uses this app to please share your mixes for me, and others, to enjoy.
